description: Implement file compaction for Iceberg tables
steps: Create `silver/maintenance.py` with maintenance operations
Implement file compaction using PyIceberg rewrite API
Target partitions with excessive small files (<64MB, >50 files)
Rewrite to target file size (256MB)
Add CLI: `prediction-data silver compact --table X [--partition Y]`
Log compaction stats: files before/after, bytes saved

description: Expire old Iceberg snapshots to control metadata size
steps: Implement snapshot expiration using PyIceberg API
Retain snapshots for configurable period (default 7 days)
Add CLI: `prediction-data silver expire-snapshots --table X --older-than-days 7`
Verify old snapshots are removed from metadata

description: Detect and remove orphaned data files
steps: Implement orphan file detection (Parquet files not referenced by metadata)
Safety check: only delete files >7 days old
Add CLI: `prediction-data silver remove-orphans --table X --dry-run`
Log orphan files found and deleted
Create maintenance runner script for all tables
Schedule compaction: daily
Schedule snapshot expiration: weekly
Schedule orphan cleanup: weekly
Integrate with EventBridge Scheduler or cron
Test compaction reduces file count
Test snapshot expiration removes old snapshots
Test orphan cleanup detects untracked files
Test dry-run modes for all operations
